title: Two Kings, One Croissant
logline: Brock and Matteo discover they're chasing the same woman; Élodie rates the entire war a five — until Spain walks in.

scenes.visual: Brock and Matteo nose to nose at the pool edge, shocked, a smoothie and a risotto pan between them

lines.speaker: brock-usa
lines.text: Bro. We're both all-in on the same girl?!

lines.speaker: matteo-italy
lines.text: Not a girl. A vision. MY vision!

scenes.visual: Élodie on a pink lounger, unimpressed; Brock offers a smoothie while Matteo presents a steaming pan

lines.speaker: brock-usa
lines.text: Élodie! Fresh mango protein. Premium, like you.

lines.speaker: matteo-italy
lines.text: Move the smoothie. Risotto of my ancestors, for the lady.

scenes.visual: Split-screen kitchen standoff: Matteo brandishing a wooden spoon, Brock cradling his blender like a baby

lines.speaker: matteo-italy
lines.text: You made her a smoothie. I made her a promise.

lines.speaker: brock-usa
lines.text: My smoothie has eighteen grams of commitment, bro!

lines.speaker: matteo-italy
lines.text: You cannot blend your way into a French heart!

scenes.visual: Poppy in the neon Spill Room armchair, tea in hand, profoundly entertained

lines.speaker: poppy-uk
lines.text: Day one, and two grown men are dueling with kitchen appliances.

lines.speaker: poppy-uk
lines.text: My money's on the blender. Only one here with a clear plan.

scenes.visual: Greta writing on her clipboard while Sienna grins and Lucas does a celebratory samba step

lines.speaker: greta-germany
lines.text: Fourteen hundred hours: America and Italy declared war. Logged.

lines.speaker: lucas-brazil
lines.text: This dance is called: International Emotional Damage!

scenes.visual: Élodie in the Spill Room, examining her nails, betraying the faintest smile

lines.speaker: elodie-france
lines.text: The smoothie? Five. The risotto? Five. The drama? ...Seven.

scenes.visual: Torch-lit walkway at night: Alejandro strides in slow motion, crimson shirt glowing, villa gawking

lines.speaker: sienna-australia
lines.text: GUYS. Walkway alert. This one's got SLOW MOTION.

lines.speaker: alejandro-spain
lines.text: I heard someone here rates men out of ten. I am the ten.

scenes.visual: End card: Who should Élodie pick? 🇺🇸 🇮🇹 🇪🇸 Vote in the comments!

caption: America and Italy declared war over France… and then SPAIN walked in 💀 Who should Élodie pick? Episode 1 of Love Villa: Nations 🌍❤️
